Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: In 2008, rookie journalist Jay Bahadur forms a half-baked plan to embed himself among the pirates of Somalia. He ultimately succeeds in providing the first close-up look into who these men are, how they live, and the forces that drive them.

programme.title: Departure
programme.desc: A man leaves a woman, a woman leaves a man. Both meet for a short while. Great changes await them at the end of this journey.

programme.title: Wild Fire
programme.desc: Dream Town Development real estate bosses Jack Del Rio and Sy Richards can't convince animal lover Carol Tanner to sell and relocate safari/animal retirement ranch Wild Land, which she runs with younger sister Ballad since their parents died in a plane crash. Jack hires Bradshaw and Roach to release tiger Caesar, after that fails to cause a scandal to start a forest fire and release all animals, after tying up Carol. Ballad's lover, committed Glendora, southern California fire captain Kennedy, and his jumper team try their best to control the fire. Meanwhile young sheriff Drake Donovan and Ballad drug and catch wild animals. The arson is discovered, but the fiends aren't done yet.

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: The story of a young orphaned boy who is sent to live with his grandfather in Ireland. The boy finds adjusting to the country life challenging, but soon learns the life has its rewards as well.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

programme.title: Last Chance
programme.desc: In a future world, mankind is about to be wiped out by a super virus, Hiding underground people only have one hope, That a meteorite will save them with a possible cure. Only one thing stands in their way from retrieving the meteorite crystal that could save them all, The infected topsiders.

programme.title: Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Whisper Island
programme.desc: Sam Dalton, a 14-year-old girl, is determined to save the only home she has ever known, the faded, dusty Romanian Princess ranch. Sam writes to a distant relative of her Aunt Christine hoping he can prevent the ranch from being repossessed. But it's J. T. Swinton, a teenage boy who shows up. In desperation they turn to a seemingly futile hope, the treasure of Whisper Island. But does the Civil War treasure really exist? The answer seems to be trapped somewhere in the wishful delusions of Aunt Christine. As the teens search for treasure in a race against time, they must also search Christine's past and unravel a web of romance, intrigue and betrayal that spans a lifetime and beyond. What they find, changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: Redemption of the Ghost
programme.desc: Convicted embezzler Witt Hampton escapes from prison and while hiding out in an isolated country barn is discovered by young Cassy and her brother Jack. After convincing them he's a friendly ghost that only they can see, the three new friends embark on one imaginative adventure after another until, inspired by their innocent spirits, Witt vows to redeem his crimes. But, a by-the-book sheriff-who has sworn to personally put Hampton back behind bars-is closing in, and Witt may never get the chance to finally set things right.

programme.title: El camino
programme.desc: Elliot, 31, a product of the Washington D.C. foster care system, has spent most of his life moving from place to place. When he is contacted by Matthew, a childhood friend from "the system" dying of cancer, Elliot goes to be by his side. At the funeral, he meets Gray and Lily, two friends of Matthew, both aimless in their present lives. Motivated by their sense of loss, and personal anger, Gray, Lily and Elliot steal Matthew's ashes and take them to Mexico. As the three travelers journey cross-country with Matthew's urn in tow, they are forced to confront their own sense of family, identity and future. Set against the changing American landscape, EL CAMINO follows these characters as they search for themselves in a country that has lost it's own identity. Gray, the wayward son of a prominent D.C. family, has left his pregnant girlfriend. He is angry, volatile and fearful of commitment. Lily is Matthew's ex-girlfriend. Unbeknownst to her parents, she has dropped out of college and become an exotic dancer. Lost in alcohol and pills she longs for her mother's approval. Elliot is outside the cultural mainstream. He carries a suitcase filled with documents and mementos of his life. An explorer of human experience, he interviews and videotapes people he meets. Haunted by dreams of his mother's drowning, Elliot struggles to find his place in the world. EL CAMINO is a humorous and compassionate film about friendship, family, and search for self in today's American landscape

programme.title: The Year Dolly Parton Was My Mom
programme.desc: Elizabeth Alison Gray is just your average suburban 11-year old waiting for adolescence to arrive when she finds out her whole life has been a lie. With only her imagination to guide her, she runs away to find the truth.

programme.title: Petunia

Petunia weaves together the lives of brothers Charlie, Adrian and Michael as they unlearn everything their psychoanalyst parents have taught them.

Igrajući ovu opasnu igru mačke i miša, Bobi nailazi na još veći izazov: vezu za jednu noć, s devojkom po imenu Lusi. Tri meseca nakon strastvene zajedničke noći, Lusi mu saopštava da je trudna. Iznenada, dva potpuno različita sveta se sudaraju, što Bobiju nalaže da preispita dotadašnji život. U gradu za koji je nekad bio nevidljiv, Bobi je sada prilično poznat i tražen.

Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se održati svoju pekaru, ali jednog dana je izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora prisiljava na zatvaranje posla. Meri sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati ka svojoj porodici u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću Brent dobija napad alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Meri odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to da bude dobra ideja?

programme.title: Crni policajac
programme.desc: Crni policajac gurnut je preko ivice, a svoje frustracije istrešće na privilegovanoj zajednici koju se zakleo da će štititi.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Terror by Night
programme.desc: Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.

programme.title: The Man with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: When illegal card dealer and recovering heroin addict Frankie Machine gets out of prison, he decides to straighten up. Armed with nothing but an old drum set, Frankie tries to get honest work as a drummer. But when his former employer and his old drug dealer re-enter his life, Frankie finds it hard to stay clean and eventually finds himself succumbing to his old habits.

programme.title: Her Lonely Lane
programme.desc: Fumiko struggles to get her literary work published, spending years working in poverty while being abused by her boyfriend all the while hoping to break free from the cycle.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: When did you last talk with your father? Will you ever ask him about those things that hurt you? In Father the reality of life is turned upside down to create an impossible dialogue _ the dialogue between a child and a father that never happens.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond in Africa
programme.desc: Drummond has to leave for Morocco on his wedding day with his fiancee and trusted friends to rescue his friend Nielsen who is kidnapped by an international criminal.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Bride
programme.desc: Hugh "Bulldog" Drummond is on the precipice of matrimony to his beloved Phyllis -- but a bank robbery and a daring escape is going to get in their way before they reach the altar.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Secret Police
programme.desc: Captain Drummond and his girlfriend want to marry but a hidden treasure in the house in which they want to celebrate their marriage is complicating the situation involving a series of deaths and an elusive murderer.

programme.desc: John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Newly appointed sheriff Pat Garrett is pleased when his old friend Doc Holliday arrives in Lincoln, New Mexico on the stage. Doc is trailing his stolen horse, and it is discovered in the possession of Billy the Kid. In a surprising turnaround, Billy and Doc become friends. This causes the friendship between Doc and Pat to cool. The odd relationship between Doc and Billy grows stranger when Doc hides Billy at his girl Rio's place after Billy is shot.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Who can she trust?

programme.title: Frieda
programme.desc: A Royal Air Force pilot who was shot down during World War II returns home to his English village with his new bride. The trouble is that she is the German lady who helped him escape. Then her brother arrives.

programme.title: Tangible
programme.desc: In a busy and chaotic city, we met Juan, a young isolated from society, with a deep need to recover the meaning of his own life. Juan goes out to encounter the city, that he lives differently, building a parallel reality, that helps him escape the tedium of the city and finally find Ana.

programme.title: Go for Broke!
programme.desc: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.

programme.desc: Marseille, today. Aminata works as a hairdresser in an Afro hairdressing salon, Badara works as mecanich. When they meet, their love story will change their lives.

programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers are forced to track down a train robbery ring after some of the gang hijack their truck for a getaway and the police conclude they are part of the gang, an identification which is just fine with the gang's nameless chief.

programme.desc: John Wayne explodes across the screen in this action-packed tale of deceit _ and revenge. In a dilapidated ghost town, John Blair (Wayne) runs afoul of the villainous Drake who attempts to cheat him out of a lucrative mail delivery contract. It all leads to a thrilling race in the gorgeous Sacramento Valley. Stagecoach Run has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time!

Guns Along the Trail has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

Besides dealing with the Black gang, Morrell has to find another robber, Jim Moore, who switches clothes with him after he finds Chris unconscious from a fight with Sam Black. programme.title: Japanese Heights
programme.desc: There is more to Japan's natural landscape than just Mount Fuji! Discover the country's numerous mountains and the ethos of the people who live there. From mountains with eight peaks, mountain gods who keep locals in their awe to building snow monsters & embracing modern activities like skiing _ this documentary shows the unseen side to Japan!

programme.title: Coral Sea Dreaming
programme.desc: Coral Sea Dreaming enters into the very heart of life _ and death _ on a coral reef. It is a story that spans 500 million years and stars some of the most exotic and wonderous marine creatures on earth. Coral is the planet's greatest natu- ral architect, and coral reefs boast the highest biodiversity of any ecosystem.

programme.title: Karen Twins
programme.desc: When they were kids, Johnny and Luther Htoo were invincible. This is at least what believed "God's Army" soldiers, a Karen guerilla group led by the 12 years old twin brothers. Today, Johnny and Luther are 27 years old. Their past glory is long gone, and their respective lives illustrate the fate of Burmese ethnic minorities who dare confronting the central government.

programme.title: Seed Hunter
programme.desc: Our planet is heating up and one of the first casualties will be the crops that supply our food. Scientists are working overtime to find solutions including going back to the ancestral origins of our staple foods. SEED HUNTER will take you on a remarkable journey from the drought ravaged farms of Australia, to the heart of the Middle East, to the mountains of Tajikistan where charismatic Australian scientist Dr Ken Street _ a real life version of Indiana Jones _ and his team of "gene detectives" hunt for plant genes that will help our food withstand the impact of 21st century global warming. Along the way we meet farmers around the world who are struggling to grow crops in a climate that's gone haywire, as well as scientists working at the front line of gene technology to save tomorrow's food. At journey's end, deep in the Arctic Circle, Ken deposits his bounty of seed in the newly constructed seed bank known as the "doomsday vault."

programme.title: The Stradivarius Complex
programme.desc: From his atelier in Barcelona, David Bagué, one of the world's most talented and charismatic luthiers, dedicates body and soul to making violins with a single purpose: to reach the transcendence Stradivarius' violins achieved.

programme.title: Madre De Dios: The Lost Island
programme.desc: In January 2017, a team of researchers set out on one of the last major geographic expeditions to Madre de Dios Island — a true terra incognita in the heart of Patagonia and Chilean Antarctica. To carry out this risky mission, speleologists, divers, geologists, botanists, and biologists faced extreme conditions while exploring this remote land, aiming to establish it as a UNESCO World Heritage site.

programme.title: Shattered Ground
programme.desc: Hydraulic Fracturing or "Fracking" is a new technology that has opened up immense resources of natural gas buried in deep shale beds. Some see it as the answer to the energy crisis and a chance at energy independence. But fracking has become an incredibly divisive issue ripping apart communities and even families. The backlash is unprecedented, with states and countries adopting fracking bans. Shattered Ground is a one hour documentary that looks past the rhetoric and emotional arguments to find the real issues involved in hydraulic fracturing, the opportunity, and the potential health and environmental issues that will affect us all.

programme.title: Lagerfield - The Kaiser Of Fashion
programme.desc: A biography of the controversial fashion savant, creator of extraordinary fashion show sets, renowned photographer, and author of breathtaking books. Lagerfeld is the quintessential renaissance man.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We'll find out why they called Minneapolis the "Mill City" when we visit the Mill City Museum. Then we march over to the Union's Fort Snelling, the first permanent structure in Minnesota, and then head underground and learn about St. Paul's organized crime hide outs.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: San Antonio is rich with Texas, Mexican, and Spanish history. We make our last stand at the Alamo, and visit Missions National Historical Park. Lastly, we spelunk the Natural Bridge Caverns underground.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Catch-and-release Chinook Salmon derby from Vancouver promoting Pacific Salmon Foundation!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Join us as we cruise the backwaters of Kerala, one of the most beautiful and serene areas of India. We explore the cities of Cochin and Kozhikode. Attend a local theatre performance and learn about traditional drama styles. The drama continues as we witness a local festival and then take in a display of the ancient art of Kalaripayattu. Bill helps raise the Chinese fishing nets at dusk and tour a 1000 year old boat yard, where luxury vessels are still handcrafted.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Every major country has a destination that is incredible but not well known to outsiders—Jaisalmer is such a place. Once a major stop along the silk road, this living museum and surrounding countryside has something for everyone: tragic history, unbelievable architecture, unique cultural groups and resilient wildlife.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is one of the few national parks in Africa where the bush meets the ocean. The big game of Africa face off with the creatures of the deep. Our host goes a little rogue for supper and tries his hand at surf netting prawns after spending a day looking for the elusive elephants of Saadani.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: In all previous Journeys' shows, only glimpses of the cheetah were seen. Here at Kruger, we get up close to this shy cat before heading out of the park and visiting a special research and breeding center dedicated to cheetahs.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: China Uncovered
programme.desc: China runs on two gears as it moves millions of people around every day. A young driver of one of the world's fastest trains and two seasoned pilots of one of the world's biggest airlines are seeing the effects modernization and globalization have on their journeys. Meanwhile, in downtown Shanghai a recreational revolution is taking place as the youth choose bikes and skateboards over four wheels.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: Napoleon Bonaparte _ Military genius and builder, he will then reign, without any intention to share his position, for over a decade and will engage, with his troupes, in many battles. His imperial army, which has reached 700 000 men, is considered in 1815, the greatest one in the world.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.desc: Paris and Berlin have developed and grown facing each other over four centuries of tumultuous historical relationships and mutual admiration. The architecture and urbanism bear witness of this complex and rich confrontation.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: The Obersalzberg was an ordinary Bavarian mountain until Adolf Hitler discovered it in 1923. There at the Berghof, the Nazi leader spent his time surrounded by his most faithful lieutenants and his mistress, Eva Braun. Though mostly destroyed, remnants of the vast building complex still exist.

programme.title: The Day When...
programme.desc: On May 28, 1940, the Wehrmacht crushed the Allied armies in France. The British prepared for a deal with Hitler, even considering mediation through Mussolini. Left alone in the war cabinet, Churchill, with his cunning and will, finally persuaded his associates to go to war.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Bienvenido a Miami! We take a look at the history behind Florida's modern metropolis. We visit the Ancient Spanish Monastery, see the opulence of the Vizcaya Museum and Gardens, and head into the swamp to learn about the Miccosukee indians.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Un-Belizable! We're off on a Central American Mayan excursion. We head up the steps of the ancient high temple at Lamanai. Then we take a city tour of the main tourist destination, Belize City. We learn about Belize's colonial roots at the Belize City History Museum and dive the amazing Blue Hole.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Chasing down Albacore Tuna 65 miles off West Coast Vancouver Island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The Golden Temple is the centerpiece of the city of Amritsar, and probably the second most photographed building in India, but few know about the building or the people who built it. The most significant building to people of the Sikh faith, it is open to people of all faiths. We witness the celebration of the changing of the guard before heading into the mountains for a visit to the British influenced town of Shimla. Journeys then heads further north for look at the resort area of Manali.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The people and wildlife of the western state of Gujarat have found ways to survive in an inhospitable environment. Unique big game exists side-by-side with some of the most talented and unique craftsman in the world. Bill gets the inside scoop on this strange land and is doubly surprised by his local guide.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: If there ever was a lost wildlife gem, it would be Mikumi. Here many of the Big Twelve live their lives against the backdrop of one of the most scenic parks in Africa. Bill takes a break from the wildlife safari to investigate the huge salt works at the edge of the park and how it may impact future conservation.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: South Africa has many different tribal groups and ethnic people, but none have a more fascinating story than the Zulu. These were once the most feared warriors in all of Africa and they have fiercely held onto that culture. They're also dedicated conservationists and we see first-hand the wildlife sanctuaries they've created. This is a proud people with a unique history, and we get to share that with them.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus. You'll also witness the fascinating hunting technique of the cuttlefish.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world's largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Archer Fish _ A precise hunter, it shoots water jets to knock prey from above. Portia Spider _ Tiny but smart, this spider hunts others with strategy and speed. Cone Shell _ A slow-moving snail with a deadly harpoon for catching fish. Bolas Spider _ Spins sticky globules to snare prey in the dark. Slave-Making Ants _ Some ants enslave others to build their colonies. Ant Lion _ A fierce larva that traps ants in sandy pits. Pompilid Wasp _ Hunts spiders with deadly precision. Who rules the micro predator world?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: We live in a world full of the most magnificent of animals. There are approximately eight point seven (8.7) million different species on earth. With this vast array of natural wonders how do we choose a favorite amongst all these spectacular creatures? The ethereal grace of the oceans whales, the might of the imposing hippo, the unequalled speed of the cheetah, the mesmerizing lure of the snake, the power of the elephant, the strength of the ant, the stealth of the scorpion, the extraordinary talents of the octopus, the force of the crocodile, the sheer grace of the wedge tailed eagle, or the regular commanding presence of the lion...

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals evolve through small mutations to better compete for resources. Crocodiles, over 200 million years old, survived extinction due to their adaptability—slow metabolism, 4-chamber heart, and lungs that allow 2-hour dives. Sharks retained successful traits from ancient ancestors, evolving gradually. Whales transitioned from land to sea, developing echolocation, blubber, modified lungs, and enhanced hearing for survival.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Hippos are terrifying animals in their own right, but they also have enough meat on them to be tempting prey. A pride of 16 lions surround one, but its jaws can crush a skull with one bite _ who will triumph?

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: On East Africa's plains, millions of wildebeest and zebras migrate, crossing the Mara and Grumeti rivers where crocodiles lie in wait. DC, a dominant croc, faces challenges at each hunting zone—from shallow waters to rocky crossings. He battles rivals, adapts his strategy, and learns to thrive in changing conditions. As the rivers dry and herds thin, DC makes one final kill. The Mara and Grumeti demand unique skills, turning quiet waters into deadly Predator Zones.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Desert creatures endure searing heat and zero rainfall, but speed is their ticket to survival.A Tiger beetle runs at the human equivalent of 500 miles per hour. A caracal jumps six feet to swat a weaverbird out of midair. And the world's fastest chameleon hunts on the desert floor.Only the hardiest, fastest animals survive. Nothing else stands a chance.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You'll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it's prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia's Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: And we're off! We learn the history of the world famous Kentucky Derby. Then, call your shot as we learn about one of America's most famous brands, Louisville Slugger. Also, we zip line in the world's only underground zip line attraction and visit the Ali Center.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: The Saints come marching in as we tour the iconic St. Louis Cathedral and the mysterious Ursuline Convent in New Orleans. We delve into Mardi Gras history at Mardi Gras World and visit the National WWII Museum's world class collection.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Annual brood stock fishery from Percy Walkus Hatchery in Wuikinuxv, Rivers Inlet...conserving the largest Chinook on Earth!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Agra is home to India's most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. First, we tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal's construction. Bill takes us to a factory where we learn how the craft of stone inlay that adorns the Taj Mahal, is still made today. We continue on to Fatehpur Sikri, a former Mughal capital, which was created of red sandstone and displays the influence of its Hindu and Mughal roots. Finally, we meet with a man that is giving the wildlife of India a voice and sanctuary.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the most sacred places in India are featured in this fascinating episode. Bill first burst the myths surrounding the legendary Khajuraho and its intricately carved temples before heading to the Holy City of Varanasi. Varanasi, the Jerusalem or Mecca for Hindus with its deep connection to the Ganges River, is explored with an insider's perspective.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World—all other great wilderness areas are compared to this vast savannah. Wildlife numbers are awesome, but nothing like the numbers of the great migration. Journeys places you in the midst of this natural phenomenon where predator and prey are on a march for survival.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Host Bill Ball begins the ascent of the highest mountain in Africa. Trouble almost immediately affects the team as the cameraman suffers from fatigue and altitude sickness. Just over halfway, the trip is in serious doubt as altitude, cold and wind force the team to evaluate their fitness to continue.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A world-class group of skiers explore epic backcountry terrain around Bralorne, B.C., areas accessible only by snowmobiles, with Canadian sled super-heroes as their guides.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Explore the windsurfing culture of Maui, and follow a Production Company as they make a Windsurfing movie. The serene island is the perfect backdrop for this sun, sea and surf extravaganza.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. They vary in size from grains of dust to mountain sides, footballs to planetoids. They were the building blocks of the planets and perhaps carry the origins of life itself. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's the city of love, Paris, France. The world over knows its most famous structure, the Eiffel Tower! But did you know parisians originally wanted to tear it down! We'll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you'll visit America's first pizzeria! And how the gourmet ice cream Haagen Dazs got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how Sweet N Low actually got its name! And why do we yell shotgun when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the potato chip was invented out of anger!

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Kraljica čokolade
programme.desc: Kirsten Tibals se vraća kao Kraljica Čokolade u svojoj šestoj, najrazigranijoj sezoni. Puna neodoljivih deserta, pametnih tehnika i nepogrešivih saveta, sezona dokazuje da čokoladna čuda kod kuće mogu biti i impresivna i dostižna uz pomoć Kraljice.

programme.title: Ukusi Italije

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Malo ljudi zna da je Stojan zaljubljen u pecanje. On ima svoje omiljene riblje recepte i ova čorba jedna je od njih. Lora i Stojan spremiće poznati fugas hleb i govedinu iz tiganja sa pečurkama i pavlakom.

programme.title: Nadijina omiljena porodična jela
programme.desc: Današnja jela su savršena za one posebne dane kada uživamo u hrani. Prvo na meniju je rolat od šunke i sira, koji je stvoren za kraljeve. Zatim sledi tortilja sa spanaćem i "paneer" sirom koja je puna arome, a za desert, slatke kugle u sirupu.

programme.title: Nadijini brzi ukusi
programme.desc: Nadija je u misiji da vrati uzbuđenje u svakodnevne obroke, sa mnogo novih načina da se poboljša ukus hrane. Pritom, ona ne poštuje pravila, jer je tako zabavno praviti neobične kombinacije ukusa! U ovim epizodama nijedan ukus neće ostati neistražen!

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvajte kao profesionalac
programme.desc: Nagrađivani kuvar Mark poziva gledaoce da preispitaju način na koji kuvaju kod kuće. Zaboravite na ideju da odlična hrana zahteva beskrajne sastojke ili sate u kuhinji. Mark pokazuje da svako može da napravi jela dostojna restorana u svojoj kuhinji.

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvar van dužnosti vraća se kući
programme.desc: Bivši svetski mladi kuvar godine slavi irske korene svojih voljenih recepata. Kuvar van dužnosti odlazi do kuće svojih roditelja u Vest Keriju, gde istražuje priobalno i seosko okruženje koje je inspirisalo neka od njegovih omiljenih jela.

programme.title: Luk Nuen: Vijetnamska železnica
programme.desc: Luk se približava polovini svog putovanja, u gradu Da Nang. Ovo je užurbani grad na obali.

programme.title: Luk Nuen: Vijetnamska železnica
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Luk odlazi u grad Hue, koji je poznat po svom kraljevskom nasleđu, drevnoj, imperijalnoj arhitekturi i bogatoj hrani.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Ukusan hrskavi bakalar sa pireom od graška, tartar sosom i toplom baštenskom salatom, delovi su Džejmijevog današnjeg menija.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Džejmi sprema piletinu na štapiću sa ukusnim soja sosom, koje servira sa ljutkastom salatom od nudla. Sve to uz voće i šećer sa mentom.

programme.title: Ukusi Italije
programme.desc: Niša Katona kreće na putovanje po Italiji kako bi otkrila skrivene dragulje lokalnog kulinarstva. Katanija, na jugozapadnoj obali Italije, prepuna je kulinarskih lepota.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Malo ljudi zna da je Stojan zaljubljen u pecanje. On ima svoje omiljene riblje recepte i ova čorba jedna je od njih. Lora i Stojan spremiće poznati fugas hleb i govedinu iz tiganja sa pečurkama i pavlakom.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: U 4. sezoni serije "Pecite sa Akisom", voljeni grčki kuvar Akis vraća se sa toplim i primamljivim receptima u kojima spaja grčko kulinarsko nasleđe sa međunarodnom inspiracijom, nudeći jednostavne tehnike i ukusne rezultate za kuvare svih nivoa.

programme.title: Rejčel Ku: Moja švedska kuhinja
programme.desc: Rejčel priprema jastoga sa roštilja sa salatom od kupusa i kima. Zatim pravi sopstvenu činiju sa lososom i povrćem, a za desert sprema kolače od bele čokolade, bobica i kokosa.

programme.title: Rejčel Ku: Moja švedska kuhinja
programme.desc: Rejčel sprema hladnog raka i servira ga sa toplom čorbom od raka i pitom od sira. Za desert sprema klasičnu švedsku tortu od sira, serviranu toplu sa šlagom i pekmezom.

programme.title: Nadijina omiljena porodična jela
programme.desc: Današnja jela su savršena za one posebne dane kada uživamo u hrani. Prvo na meniju je rolat od šunke i sira, koji je stvoren za kraljeve. Zatim sledi tortilja sa spanaćem i "paneer" sirom koja je puna arome, a za desert, slatke kugle u sirupu.

programme.title: Nadijini brzi ukusi
programme.desc: Nadija je u misiji da vrati uzbuđenje u svakodnevne obroke, sa mnogo novih načina da se poboljša ukus hrane. Pritom, ona ne poštuje pravila, jer je tako zabavno praviti neobične kombinacije ukusa! U ovim epizodama nijedan ukus neće ostati neistražen!

programme.title: Kuhinje sveta
programme.desc: Niki degustira jelo koje se nekada nudilo bogovima u afričko-brazilskoj kulturi. Tradicionalni ručak se završava popodnevnim koktelom kajpirinja, koji je nacionalni koktel Brazila. Niki priprema rižu i pasulj sa piletinom i pomfeze od crnog pasulja.

programme.title: Kuhinje sveta
programme.desc: Nakon doručka na srednjovekovnim pijacama, Niki uči kako se pravi lokalna marokanska pita, koju potom peče u podzemnim pekarama. Zatim, Niki uči kako se pravi kuskus. Kod kuće, Niki pravi slatko-slanu pitu "bastilla" i slatki kuskus sa karamelom.

programme.title: Pol Holivud: Kulinarsko putovanje kroz Japan
programme.desc: Pol Holivud nastavlja svoje kulinarsko putovanje Japanom. Ukrcava se na brzi voz i putuje do Okinave, gde uči tajne kuvanja od čoveka koji je preživeo atomsku bombu bačenu na Hirošimu.

programme.title: Gospođica niko i ništa
programme.desc: Sara Jane je nesrećna u ljubavi, živi sa svojom ekscentričnom majkom i radi u firmi Judge Pharmaceuticals kao sekretarica bez ikakve perspektive za unapređenje. Iznenadno unapređenje na menadžersko mesto izgleda kao ono što je tražila. Ipak, zajedno s unapređenjem pojavljuje se novi svet, pun konkurencije od strane drugih poslovodja, spletki i komplikacija. Sara počinje da eliminiše konkurenciju na jedini način koji zna _ ubija. Na putu ka vrhu iznenada upoznaje muškarca svojih snova _ detektiva Billa Malloya, koji namerava da otkrije tajne smrti u Judge Pharmaceuticals.

programme.title: Tvoj srećan dan
programme.desc: Nakon što spor oko dobitnog loto tiketa preraste u smrtonosnu talačku situaciju, svedoci moraju da odluče koliko su daleko spremni da idu i koliko krvi su spremni da proliju za svoj deo od 156 miliona dolara.

programme.title: Zajednički rat
programme.desc: U Drugom svetskom ratu, odred afroameričkih vojnika odlazi iza neprijateljskih linija u misiju spasavanja svog nestalog komandanta i oborenog pilota lovca.

programme.title: Noćas nećeš spavati
programme.desc: Dečaka progone zastrašujuće noćne more u kojima se čudovište krije u ormaru. Na njegovo olakšanje, otac se pojavljuje usred noći kako bi mu pomogao da se suoči sa svojim strahovima. Ali dečak počinje da preispituje pravu prirodu tih prikaza, primoran da se suoči sa istinom o sudbini svog oca i zloj sili koja preti da ga obuzme.

programme.title: Strašna strana istorije: Pokvareni Rimljani
programme.desc: Mladi Rimljanin Ati primoran je da se pridruži rimskoj vojsci kada jedna od njegovih "lukavih smicalica" zasmeta lično Neronu. Šalju ga u "bednu, hladnu i vlažnu Britaniju", čiji se stanovnici bune. Stvari postaju još gore kad Atija zarobi Orla, opasna mlada Keltkinja koja gori od želje da se dokaže kao ratnica. Nakon što je za dlaku izbegao vrlo gadan kraj u močvari, Ati koristi znanje stečeno u Rimu kako bi pomogao Orli da spase svoju baku, koju je kidnapovalo suparničko pleme. U međuvremenu, besni Neron odlučuje da uguši pobunu koju predvodi Budika, kraljica Icenija. Ati se ponovo pridružuje rimskim trupama i otkriva da se spremaju za istorijski obračun sa Keltima u bici kod Votling strita. Ati bi mogao sve da zaustavi, ali i da dovede do katastrofe za Orlu, jer se dvoje novopečenih prijatelja sada nalaze na suprotnim stranama bojnog polja.

programme.title: Penina senka
programme.desc: Tokom odmora na ostrvu Ejmland, devojka otkriva opasnog konja koji nema poverenja u ljude. Da bi dokazala da konj uopšte nije opasan, devojka ga potajno obučava kako bi ponovo stekao poverenje u ljude.

programme.title: Pirati sa Velikog Slanog Jezera
programme.desc: Kirk Redgrejv je sanjar koji živi s majkom, sve dok njegovo tajno piratsko životarenje ne bude otkriveno i primora ga na selidbu. Sa sobom vodi simpatičnog Flinta i zajedno kreću na Veliko slano jezero, praveći haos među slučajnim turistima i amaterskim mornarima. Kada naiđu na pravu mapu ukletog blaga, počinje luda potraga u kojoj ih prate čudni likovi takođe u lovu na bogatstvo. Ovo je zabavna i neobična priča o prijateljstvu i najluđim fantazijama dvojice ekscentrika.

programme.title: Crveno nebo
programme.desc: Osramoćeni "top gan" pilot Buč Masters predvodi odmetnuti vod koji mora da povrati kataklizmičko oružje za masovno uništenje. Kada otkrije da njegov bivši partner Tom Kreg radi za teroriste, Masters se mora izboriti s uništenim prijateljstvom i ljubavnim trouglom, ali i upustiti u vazdušnu bitku kako bi povratio vojničku i ličnu čast.

programme.title: Poznat

programme.desc: Usvojeni dečak sprijatelji se sa izgubljenim psom za kog se ispostavlja da pripada predsedniku Sjedinjenih Država. On odluči da pobegne od kuće i vrati psa u Belu kuću, jer je to po njemu jedino ispravno.

programme.title: Čarlijevi anđeli

Kada ih zločinački genije uvuče u zaveru koja preti da ukine pravo na privatnost, Anđeli uz pomoć vernog Boslija kreću da ga zaustave. Ali otkriće strašne tajne pretvara ih u mete ubica.

programme.title: Polje izgubljenih cipela
programme.desc: Zasnovano na istinitoj priči iz Američkog građanskog rata. Kadetski tinejdžeri sa Vojnog instituta u Virdžiniji, zaštićeni od ratnih užasa, iznenada su pozvani da brane dolinu Šenandoa u bici kod Nju Marketa 1864. godine. Primorani da prerano ostave svoju mladost iza sebe, ovi kadeti moraju odlučiti za šta se tačno bore.

programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.desc: Sedamnaestogodišnji učenik, koji je čitavog života izbegavao da pokaže zube, prinuđen je da se konačno izbori za sebe, svoju porodicu i svoju budućnost u dirljivoj priči o identitetu i odrastanju.

programme.title: Svi putevi vode u Rim
programme.desc: Megi je samohrana majka i fakultetska profesorka iz Njujorka. U pokušaju da pronađe zajednički jezik sa Samer, svojom ćerkom tinejdžerkom, Megi odlazi u selo u Toskani, gde je kao mlada provela mnogo vremena. Odmah po dolasku nailazi na Luku, zgodnog bivšeg momka koji je i dalje neženja i živi sa svojom osamdesetogodišnjom majkom Karmen. Samer, kojoj nedostaje žestoki momak iz Njujorka, zajedno sa Karmen, koja uprkos Lukinom protivljenju planira da se uda za Marselina, svoju jedinu pravu ljubav, impulsivno krade Lukina kola i beži u Rim. Megi i Luka kreću u poteru za njima.

programme.title: Krvoproliće

Prihvatanje ovog izazova donosi nove poglede na život njemu, ali i deci u timu. Zasnovano na knjizi "Hardball: A Season in the Projects" Danijela Kojla.

programme.title: Oči zmaja
programme.desc: Sent Džud je kraj koji živi u strahu i očajanju. Rivalske bande lokalnih dilera Daša i Antoana terorišu ulice i građani žive bez trunke nade, sve dok u grad ne stigne tajanstveni stranac, Rajan Hong (Cung Le). Ubrzo počinje da zavađa dve bande, a u sukobu s njima koristi svoje neverovatne borilačke veštine, koje je naučio od svog briljantnog mentora Tijana (Žan-Klod Van Dam). Ali, baš kada je počeo da pomaže zajednici, Hong upoznaje gospodina V. Isprva je gospodin V oduševljen Hongovim veštinama, ali ubrzo shvata da je on pretnja njegovom poretku, pa počinje borba ove dvojice ratnika. S jedne strane su strah i korumpiranost sistema gospodina V, a s druge novi početak koji Hong donosi stanovnicima Sent Džuda.

programme.title: Loši momci 2
programme.desc: Detektivi Markus Barnet i Majk Louri iz jedinice za narkotike u Majamiju dobijaju zadatak da zaustave dotok ekstazija u grad. Trag ih vodi do poremećenog kubanskog narko-bosa Džonija Tapije, koji je usput u krvavom ratu s ruskom i haićanskom mafijom. Kao da to nije dovoljno, među partnerima dolazi do tenzije kada Markus otkrije da zavodnik Majk krišom izlazi s njegovom sestrom, Sid.

programme.title: Bezbožnik: Ispovest serijskog ubice
programme.desc: Kriminalistički misterija zasnovana na stvarnim transkriptima razgovora između agenta FBI Billa Hagmaiera i ozloglašenog serijskog ubice Teda Bundyja tokom njegovih poslednjih godina na smrtnoj kazni. Film istražuje njihov složen odnos, dok Bundy Hagmaieru otkriva intimne detalje svog života i zločina. Kako Hagmaier ulazi dublje u Bundyjevu psihu, suočava se sa moralnim i psihološkim implikacijama njihove interakcije. Priča kulminira Bundyjevim pogubljenjem usred medijske histerije, ostavljajući dubok utisak na Hagmaier-a.

programme.title: Pion
programme.desc: Sitna pljačka prerasta u napetu talačku krizu kada trojica naoružanih napadača opljačkaju restoran koji služi kao paravan za mafijaške poslove.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Hajdi
programme.desc: Omiljena priča o Hajdi stiže na velike ekrane! S više od pedeset miliona prodatih knjiga širom sveta, prevedena na preko pedeset jezika, Hajdi je već svetska zvezda.Nežna priča o detinjstvu i prijatelstvu za čitavu porodicu.

programme.title: Restoran
programme.desc: Ova zabavna i topla dramedija smeštena je unutar uzbudljive kulinarske scene San Franciska. Priča prati Sala Sartinija, radišnog kuvara, koji mora pronaći način da ponovo raspali svoju ljubav prema kuvanju, ali i da popravi odnose sa svojim sinom, pre nego što još jednom sve stavi na kocku.

programme.title: Izgubljeno blago Džesija Džejmsa
programme.desc: Tim dece iz Misurija pokušava da reši sto godina staru misteriju i spasi svoje prijatelje u ovoj porodičnoj akcionoj avanturi. Duboko u drevne pećine, oni moraju da pobegnu lovcima na blago koji su im za petama, ili da budu zauvek izgubljeni.

programme.title: Intergalaktičke avanture Maksa Klauda
programme.desc: Svemirska krstarica pada na ljubičastu planetu Hinus, intergalaktički zatvor u kom borave najopasniji i najveći zločinci u galaksiji.

programme.title: Dnevnik Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Na početku Nove godine, 32-godišnja Bridžet odlučuje da preuzme kontrolu nad svojim životom i počinje da vodi dnevnik. Ubrzo se nađe rastrzana između šarmantnog Danijela i ozbiljnog Marka, dok posao i prijatelji dodatno komplikuju njen haotični svet.

programme.title: Bridžet Džouns na ivici razuma
programme.desc: Četiri nedelje od početka njene nove veze, Bridžet počinje da sumnja u Marka. Osim što otkriva da glasa za konzervativce, suočava se sa novim šefom, čudnim saradnikom i najgorim odmorom u životu.

programme.title: Beba Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Nakon raskida s Markom Darsijem, Bridžet, ponovo sama i u svojim četrdesetim, posvećuje se poslu i prijateljima, uverena da sve drži pod kontrolom. A onda upoznaje šarmantnog Amerikanca Džeka i ostaje trudna. Problem je u tome što nije sigurna ko bi mogao da bude otac.

programme.title: Bridžet Džouns: Luda za njim
programme.desc: Bridžet, kao udovica i samohrana majka, uz pomoć porodice, prijatelja i bivšeg ljubavnika Danijela pokušava da pronađe balans. Vraća se poslu i dejting aplikacijama, gde je privlači mlađi muškarac, koji je sasvim slučajno i učitelj njenog sina.

programme.title: 50 prvih sastanaka
programme.desc: Henri Rot je muškarac koji beži od vezivanja, sve dok ne upozna prelepu Lusi. Njih dvoje odmah pronalaze zajednički jezik i Henri misli da je konačno pronašao devojku svojih snova... sve dok ne otkrije da ona pati od gubitka kratkoročnog pamćenja i da ga već sledećeg dana neće poznavati.

programme.title: Džoker
programme.desc: Nik Vajld je telohranitelj iz Las Vegasa. Poznaje borilačke veštine i ima kockarski problem. Kad mu prijatelja premlati sadistički siledžija, Nik uzvraća udarac, ali saznaje da je siledžija sin opasnog kriminalca. Nik se iznenada obreo u svetu kriminala, a jure ga zajedno policija i mafija. Niku ostaje samo jedan potez, a ovog puta moraće da igra na sve ili ništa.

programme.title: Ponoć u plavoj travi
programme.desc: FBI agent i savezni policajac iz Floride udružuju se kako bi istražili niz nerešenih ubistava.

programme.title: Mračne tajne Kenedija i Sinatre
programme.desc: Neverovatna priča o prijateljstvu dve najveće ikone 20. veka; kako su se upoznali, koje žene i tajne su delili; i kako je sve pošlo po zlu. Džon F. Kenedi i Frenk Sinatra su bila dva najveća imena 1960-ih u Americi. Prvi put su se upoznali u mafijaškom hotelu Sends, u Las Vegasu, i odmah se zbližili. Sinatra je dovodio holivudske žene i glamur, a Kenedi je nudio klasu i stil visokog društva. Njihova ljubav prema zabavama i švaleraciji bila je nesputana. Uz veze s kriminalcima i Sinatrin status zvezde kojim ga je podržao, Kenedi je postao predsednik 1960. Ali uprkos tome što su mu pomogli da dođe do Bele kuće, čikaški kriminalni sindikalci su bili konstantno na meti Kenedijeve administracije, a predsednik je naglo prekinuo sve veze s mafijom, uključujući i Sinatru. Sinatra je bio razočaran i ponižen, a njih dvojica više nisu progovorili.

programme.title: Seks bez granica
programme.desc: Šta to ljudi zaista rade iza zatvorenih vrata Koliko znate o seksualnom životu vaših komšija, kolega ili porodice? Ovaj razotkrivajući, detaljan i jedinstven serijal filmova bavi se nekonvencionalnom stranom seksa i istražuje kako on može da unapredi živote ljudi, poveća im bogatstvo i unapredi odnose. Od BDSM-a, submisivnih i dominirajućih veza, do amaterskih porno zvezda i onih koji uživaju u trojkama, epizode će otkriti ne tako skrivene želje širokog sloja ljudi iz svih delova sveta. Serijal takođe istražuje uspon onlajn porno sajtova poput OnlyFans, koji unose revoluciju u porno industriju, a istražiće i sve veće globalne zahteve za seks lutkama.

programme.title: Hitlerove tajne misije
programme.desc: 6 tajnih, politički osetljivih i visoko složenih misija. Sve su visokog rizika s potpuno različitim ishodima. Sve su dizajnirane i naručene lično od Adolfa Hitlera i izvršene od strane njegovih najboljih zapovednika. Nakon pažljivog i detaljnog istraživanja u nemačkim, engleskim, italijanskim državnim arhivama i u tajnim arhivima Vatikana, ove priče sada mogu biti ispričane. "Hitlerove Tajne Misije" je temeljita i dubinska istraga o tim odvažnim, hrabrim i nemilosrdnim operacijama, osmišljenim i naređenim od strane Hitlera, dok je nastojao kontrolisati sudbinu Evrope i odrediti tok Drugog svetskog rata i njegov ishod.

programme.title: Naučne minijature
programme.desc: "Naučne minijature" je zabavna i intrigantna naučna serija koja testira znanje gledalaca o različitim naučnim temama. Privlači gledaoce iznenađujućim činjenicama, brzim kvizovima i zanimljivim mišljenjima. "Naučne minijature" koristi šest stručnjaka koji nas vode kroz različite oblasti kao što su životinje, svemir i planete.

programme.title: Dinastija Kim: sve ostaje u porodici
programme.desc: Konačni plan opstanka Severne Koreje. U geopolitici našeg vremena Severna Koreja zauzima centralno mesto. Nalazi se pri vrhu međunarodne agende velikih sila zbog svoje strategije stalnih pretnji, koju sprovode tri uzastopne generacije vladajuće porodice. Uz pomoć vodećih stručnjaka, među kojima su i bivši zvaničnici režima u Pjongjangu, ovaj film nastoji da otkrije konačni plan Severne Koreje, njen cilj i koliko je daleko spremna da ide kako bi ga ostvarila.
